title: Magazine p. 44: Gemini-6 "bulls eye" photo S-65-65296, S-IV-B SLA panels, Gemini-9 view
description: Photocopied magazine page of numbered photographs with captions. Photo 8 shows people examining photos, captioned as the author and NASA photo analyst Richard Underwood showing "space UFO" photos to Dr. J. Allen Hynek in July 1976; photo 9 is a fuzzy circular blob described as "an out of focus photo of the approaching Gemini-7 spaceship, nose on. NASA photo S-65-65296"; photo 10 shows the "Saturn booster S-IV-b and four open 'SLA' panels" marked "USA." Photo 11 shows an astronaut inside a capsule, captioned "The view from inside early space capsules was limited and often plagued by dirty windows and bright reflections. Gene Cernan, Gemini-9. NASA photo S-66-38024."
